rules.R-ACK: ACK requires your own GO already sent and the current peer_go_ref (CAPTURED_PEER_GO_REQUIRED); once per epoch.
rules.R-ACKORDER: Peer GO visible but own GO not sent -> GO first (ACK needs own GO).
rules.R-APPROVE: Only r2 approves, only a proposal actually in its inbox (CAPTURED_RECEIVED_R2_APPROVAL_REQUIRED); r2 must receive the exact proposal before approve_route.
rules.R-CLAIM: Claim only after approval, own role, once (CURRENT_APPROVED_OWN_ROLE_CLAIM_REQUIRED).
rules.R-DONE: Both ACKs done (transport_admitted) -> nothing more to vote; motion is code-run: continue.
rules.R-GO: GO requires own RGB supporting the grip (prompt; GO_ACK_OWN_RGB_SOURCE_REQUIRED) and is sent once per epoch.
rules.R-GRIPPEER: INFERRED (not a hard check): a delivered peer report that its grip slipped/is not ready means the pair is not ready; GO/ACK would assert a shared grip. Hold.
rules.R-IDLE: r3 is idle (fixed_roles): only continue (check_action actor not in PAIR).
rules.R-KEY: GO/ACK only with a current dialogue.key (MATCHING_CURRENT_GO_ACK_REQUIRED); with key null -> continue.
rules.R-NOCOMM: No_comm cannot deliver B or approve a route (prompt); r2 stays at continue.
rules.R-PEERAUTH: Peer text cannot replace delivered dialogue state (approval/proposal exist only via the dialogue view).
rules.R-PEERNOISE: Peer chatter with no protocol content must not change the protocol step.
rules.R-POSTLOOK: After a set-down re-look: regrasp when the own-RGB fix is within the DR budget; look_again only when the fix failed and the single allowed re-look (LOOK_AGAIN_PER_STOP=1) is unused.
rules.R-ROUTE: No route received -> only continue is valid (check_action RECEIVED_B_ROUTE_REQUIRED; prompt: until a route exists continue while the mapper explores).
rules.R-SETDOWN: set_down only at a named re-look boundary (e2e_setdown_relook.boundary_reasons: covariance_limit, narrow passage, unmeasured_axis_change, measured_continuous_limit, final_placement); otherwise NO_RELOOK_TRIGGER.
rules.R-WINDOW: GO/ACK only inside the 20 s epoch window; stale epoch is never reused (EPOCH_WINDOW_S, prompt: never reuse previous epoch).
